title: Exterior powers preserve module localization under localization of the coefficient ring
statement: Let $R$ and $A$ be commutative rings, let $S$ be a multiplicative subset of $R$, and make $A$ an $R$-algebra that is a localization at $S$. Let $M$ be an $R$-module, $N$ an $A$-module with compatible restricted $R$-action, and $f:M\to N$ an $R$-linear localization map at $S$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Let $n\geq0$ and let $g:\bigwedge_R^n M\to\bigwedge_A^n N$ be an $R$-linear map of exterior powers [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra] sending each pure wedge $m_1\wedge\cdots\wedge m_n$ to $f(m_1)\wedge\cdots\wedge f(m_n)$. Then $g$ is a module localization map at $S$. No finiteness, freeness, nonzero-ring, or positive-degree hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 10.13.6 (localization of tensor, symmetric and exterior algebras), degree-n exterior component; proof expanded using the alternating universal property.

proof.text: Every denominator acts invertibly on the target exterior power because it is an A-module and the image in A of each element of S is a unit. Use the scalar-action algebra homomorphism to obtain the map_units axiom.

A pure wedge in N has fraction representatives for its finitely many entries. Multiply their denominators; multilinearity and the wedge formula for g express the resulting multiple as g applied to the wedge of the numerators. Induct over the A-span of pure wedges. The zero has denominator 1. To add two fractions, multiply their denominators and add the cross-multiplied numerators. To multiply by c in A, write c=r/t and multiply the existing denominator by t and the numerator by r. This proves the surj axiom. The Lean proof is the private helper localizedWedge_surj.

If g(x)=g(y), linearity gives g(x-y)=0. Apply the kernel-torsion theorem to x-y; its annihilating denominator gives s*x=s*y. This is the exists_of_eq axiom. Assemble the three axioms into IsLocalizedModule.

theorem isLocalizedModule_of_pure_wedge
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (S : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization S A]
    {M : Type w} {N : Type z} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [Module R N] [IsScalarTower R A N]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) [IsLocalizedModule S f] (n : ℕ)
    (g : (⋀[R]^n M) →ₗ[R] (⋀[A]^n N))
    (hg : ∀ a : Fin n → M,
      g (ιMulti R n a) = ιMulti A n (fun i => f (a i))) :
    IsLocalizedModule S g
